pulse.text: **GPT-5.6's launch odds firmed back up** — Polymarket now prices it at **89% by Jul 31** (up from 82% last sweep), with the 50/50 crossover sliding earlier to **~Jul 10** (was ~Jul 13), reversing the overnight cooling. Otherwise a **quiet morning**: no new models, and the board holds with **Claude Opus 4.8 still #1 at AA-Index 56** (v4.1) over GPT-5.5 (55) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (46). On the race, **Anthropic's best-model odds for July eased to 82%** (from 86%), though it still dominates; for the year-end #1 crown the field is wide open — **OpenAI 32%, Google 29%, xAI 15%**. **Fable 5 hit day 15** of the US export freeze still fully offline, with near-term restoration nudging up to **34% by Jul 1** (84% by Jul 31). GPT-6 held flat at **62% by year-end**, while the day's news stayed off-model: four senior Google DeepMind researchers jumped to Anthropic/OpenAI in a week, and a House bill would make data-center builders pay for AI's grid strain.
